title: Defect pair: the visit functions are the machine, in Lean
text: Lean proves that the four visit functions of 1RB0LE_0LC0RA_1LE0RD_0RB---_0LF0LD_1LA0LF are runs of its transition table, and the round law 0 S → 0 1 0 A(S). So it never halts if every round's defect dies in its round, which is now the whole open question. The twin 1RB0LF_1LC1RC_0RA0LD_0LE1RE_0RF0LC_1RC--- follows the same rounds on random tapes too, not only along its run.
